    Finite and infinite half-words #

    A half-word is finite (fin C) or infinite (inf f). Its code at position i is 0 for an inverse letter, 2 for a direct letter and 1 past the end; the lexicographic order of codes orders the half-words at (v, s) (inverse continuation < end < direct continuation). Valid half-words at (v, s) are determined by their codes (code_injective).

    For an infinite half-word, C⁺ = ⨅ₙ (C_{<n})^* M and C⁻ = ⨆ₙ (C_{<n})^* 0.
